existing_mapping.evidence: The ParkingLot class stores a unique identifier, name, address, and city.
ParkingLot class includes an attribute for available spaces, indicating the number of spots available.
There is an association in the model indicating that each vehicle is linked to one client.
ParkingSession class includes attributes for start time and links to vehicle details.
The ParkingSpace class has an attribute for vehicle size, indicating suitability for different vehicles.
Conveyor class includes a maximum weight capacity attribute for transporting vehicles.
Conveyors are associated with vehicles, but there is no requirement to store them at the end of the parking session.
Each ParkingLot can have a separate PriceList with specified prices for different durations.
The model contains a ClubMembership class, indicating the presence of a client club management system.
ClubMembership class contains a discount rate attribute for automatic discount calculations.
Rules regarding the first free parking session for club members in their registration month are included.
Ability to generate an Annual Summary Report is indicated with relevant class elements.
LotReport includes details on payments and vehicle counts for the Annual Summary Report.
The requirement for sorting the summary report by city and payment amounts is reflected.
The generation of reports in PDF and XML format is covered in the requirements.
The structure for generating a Customer Club Growth Report is apparent in the model elements.
Customer Club Growth Report includes monthly new members, cumulative totals, and growth rates.
Customer Club Growth Report is organized by month in ascending order.

uncovered_fragments.fragment: Administrator class has 'email' and 'role' attributes but no clear operation for updating parking lot details.
uncovered_fragments.label: Domain Mistake
uncovered_fragments.reason: The guidelines require that an administrator should be able to update parking lot details, and this responsibility is not operationalized.

uncovered_fragments.fragment: GateSensor class is present, but its role in real-time vehicle data transmission and interaction with the system is not clearly defined.
uncovered_fragments.label: Domain Mistake
uncovered_fragments.reason: The guidelines specify that gate sensors must communicate vehicle data to the system in real-time, which is not shown.

uncovered_fragments.fragment: System lacks clear mechanism to assign a conveyor and run an optimization algorithm as per Conveyor Controller role.
uncovered_fragments.label: Domain Mistake
uncovered_fragments.reason: The guidelines suggest an optimization algorithm involving conveyors which the model fails to represent.

uncovered_fragments.fragment: No class or operation indicating that an SMS with parking details is sent to the client's phone.
uncovered_fragments.label: Domain Mistake
uncovered_fragments.reason: Guidelines specify this as a required feature for client communication, yet it is missing from the model.

uncovered_fragments.fragment: System does not show interaction with an external Payment Gateway for handling payments.
uncovered_fragments.label: Domain Mistake
uncovered_fragments.reason: External payment process interactions are essential as per guidelines, but they are absent in the model.

uncovered_fragments.fragment: System lacks representation of the client's ability to select and store preferred parking lots.
uncovered_fragments.label: Domain Mistake
uncovered_fragments.reason: The guidelines mention this functionality as important for club members but it is not depicted in the model.
